Field.Label: Log detailed polling results to the Indigo event log.

Each relay is set to tell Indigo the moment it switches (its own "actions" settings), so a change at the wall or in the Shelly app shows at once instead of within 30 seconds. Any other addresses you have set in those actions are kept. Reload the plugin after changing this.
The address your Shellys use to reach this Mac. Read from INDIGO_SERVER_IP in IndigoSecrets.py first; this field is the fallback.
Change only if something else already uses 8179 (Shelly Direct uses 8178), then reload the plugin.
Show Device Activity in the Indigo Event Log:

Off by default. Every on and off command is written to this plugin's own log file (Indigo's Logs folder). Tick this to have it echoed into the shared Indigo Event Log as well. Warnings and errors always appear in the Event Log, and so does a relay pulse.
